as_of.description: The time the first page loaded. Later pages rank as of that time: observations, views, dismissals and impressions after it are ignored, so pages do not shift under a reader who scrolls.

categories.description: Comma-separated kinds of moment to include: `failure` (errors, failed requests, dead ends), `struggle` (repeated attempts, rage clicks, abandoned forms), `revenue` (failed payments, cancellations, usage limits). Defaults to all three. A pick keeps its rank within its scanner, so leaving a kind out drops its sessions without promoting weaker ones.

created_by.description: Comma-separated user IDs. Restrict the feed to observations from scanners those users created.

date_from.description: Only observations created at or after this time. Accepts ISO 8601, a relative date like `-7d`, or `now`; values without an explicit offset are interpreted in the project's timezone. The window between `date_from` and `date_to` may span at most 90 days.

date_to.description: Only observations created at or before this time. Same formats as `date_from`; omit it to query through the current time.

limit.description: Ceiling on feed items to return per page, at most 50. A page routinely returns fewer: a window is not padded to this number with clips that carry no finding.

offset.description: How many ranked items to skip. Send `as_of` with every page after the first.

scanner_ids.description: Comma-separated scanner UUIDs to restrict the feed to. Defaults to every scanner you can read.

scanner_type.description:
Restrict the feed to observations from scanners of this type.

* `monitor` - Monitor
* `classifier` - Classifier
* `scorer` - Scorer
* `summarizer` - Summarizer
* `experiment` - Experiment

tags.description: Comma-separated scanner tags to restrict the feed to. A team with many scanners uses these to follow one area without naming every scanner in it.
